We strive to create an environment where underrepresented groups feel empowered.
We’re focused on increasing our hiring of women and underrepresented communities in technology, tracking our success, and adjusting to ensure a diverse, representative workforce.
We dedicate ourselves to building a just, decent, and inclusive company.
It includes an ongoing commitment to ensuring that we’re equitable in how we develop, promote and reward employees.
While we’re proud of this progress, we will continue to hold ourselves accountable and commit to our community to become the diverse company we aspire to be.
We thrive on seamless collaboration and shared success while embracing diversity and individuality.

We’ve adapted our processes to let candidates meet with employees from their representative communities during their interview process, write more inclusive job descriptions, and boost our social inclusivity globally. “I felt welcomed from the very start and have the support and encouragement to succeed.
We must be empathetic to the experience of underrepresented groups and act to make NVIDIA a place of opportunities.
We want to attract the world's best people who reflect different perspectives to help us deliver life-changing breakthroughs.
This is the diversity that fuels our innovation and creativity and unlocks endless opportunities for everyone who works to make them a reality.
We adapt to our employees' diverse needs to support them at every step of their personal and professional growth.
We’ve achieved pay parity for the past several years and are committed to continuing this practice.
Tackling the world’s greatest challenges takes fresh, new ideas based on unique perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures.
We believe that if we take care of our employees and their families, they will bring their best selves to work every day.

Through our CARE Allyship Program, we train our people to unlock the power of diversity and inclusion and take action to help others succeed. “The Allyship Program taught me how to be more attentive to the needs of underrepresented groups and how to create a space for people to be seen and heard.”
We also work with Black in AI, Black Tech Nation, Color Stack, the National GEM Consortium, and Qwaser to open up training opportunities for black communities.
We’re an eclectic, passionate group of professionals dedicated to solving some of the world’s biggest challenges.
Our Community Resource Groups (CRGs) have an impactful role in the NVIDIA experience–from leading celebrations to advocacy–and are integral to building an inclusive culture.
At NVIDIA, our people matter most.
NVIDIA has always been fearless about taking on new challenges, and we encourage and support employees who share the same values.
We do this because it is right and just, and we believe it will help make NVIDIA better.
It’s always been a dream to bring my full self to work.

We provide tailored mentoring programs, job-shadowing experiences, and leadership development opportunities. “NVIDIA has created the right conditions for me to thrive and do my life's work–elevating the employee experience through inclusion and belonging.” For the first time in my career, I can be myself, I don’t have to pretend to fit into a specific mold to be successful.

We tap into diverse student organizations at more than 25 university campuses, including Minority Serving Institutions, Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs), and Hispanic-Serving Institutions (HSIs).
But progress goes beyond pay parity.

NVIDIA supports nine CRGs and support groups for neuro diversity, caregivers, and working parents. “As a co-lead for ADHD NVIDIANs, I know firsthand how it is possible for someone who is neurodivergent to feel seen and included.
The project is the boss—even for our CEO.
No matter where you come from-,…you are part of one team.”
Being neurodivergent has enabled me to see how different pieces connect to provide a world-class experience.”
